title: Product detail page — headphones audio store
notes: v2 is a React rebuild styled with Emotion (css-* hashes). A fixed 'Quick buy' bar is injected at the top of <body> with its own price and 'Add to cart' button; the accessory rail gains 'Add to cart' buttons. Colour swatches move into <ft-variant-picker>'s shadow root (option names as values, new 'Moss Green' colour, different order). The gallery thumbnails become a vertical tablist with a video thumbnail inserted first. Info links become role=tab buttons in a new order, and the reviews move into the third-party <ft-reviews> shadow root, re-sorted by 'Most recent' with a new review on top and 'Helpful (n)' vote buttons.
